notes:
CRM notes (shorthand):
- Contact: COO Priya Anand, Head of Eng Marcus Lee.
- Primary ask: survive seasonal retail spikes (Black Friday-like) and unplanned incidents w/out >30min queue growth.
- Current infra: hybrid CPaaS (Genesys + cloud workers). Agent assist already in pilot (on-prem NLU) but fails under 3x traffic.
- Metric targets: p95 response <350ms baseline; acceptable p95 <700ms during 3x sustained bursts; recovery to baseline within 15m after spike.
- Peak numbers: normal concurrent chat agents ~3k; season peaks expected to 12k-15k concurrent interactions (2-3 hour windows). Backpressure currently causes queue delays >45m and manual escalations.
- Tooling: needs function/tool calling to CRM + case-creation APIs (Salesforce + internal ticket service). Must support idempotent calls and clear retry semantics.
- Routing: want policy-based routing by region and SLA tier; automatic fallback to quantized smaller model when dedicated pool exhausted. Also want prefix/KV caching for agent histories.
- Security: must show SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence, KMS integration, and option for on-prem inference for EU/regulated customers. Data residency required for EU customers.
- Quote from Priya: "We need something that holds during the holiday surge — if agents are blocked, business impact is immediate."
- POC notes: will run two controlled spike windows (3x and 5x) against a shadow traffic mirror, measure p50/p95/p99 and error modes. Logging hooks required for per-request tracing.
- Integration risks: CPaaS integration scheduling (vendor maintenance windows), token ingress limits on Genesys side.
- Follow ups: get security pack + sample SLA, schedule infra alignment call week of 2026-03-15.
